title: Per-element themes
blurb: Every button, field, checkbox, slider, table and heading on a booking form is wrapped in its own small canvas by <canvas-skin>. A theme switch changes all of them between twelve skins, among them refracting glass, pencil, gel, a thermal camera, a neon sign, embroidery, polished metal, sea and space, one after another outward from the tap.
question: Can a page be themed by wrapping each element in a small drawable canvas of its own, instead of drawing the whole page with one canvas, and do the wrapped controls still take input?
result: Yes in Chromium 157, with one 2D context per element. The shader skins share one WebGL context on a canvas outside the document and copy its output with drawImage().
